# About this edition {.unnumbered}

This is an unofficial Quarto rendering of *Python for Everybody: Exploring
Data Using Python 3* by Charles R. Severance. The official book, videos,
autograded exercises, and code live at <https://www.py4e.com/>.

The chapter files in this folder are generated from the book's master
Markdown sources (`book3/*.mkd` in <https://github.com/csev/py4e>) by the
script `yr-materials/tools/mkd2qmd.py`. Re-run that script after pulling
upstream changes to refresh them.
